params.name: page
params.description: Page number of results to return.

params.name: descending
params.description: Sort results in descending order when true.

params.name: industry
params.description: Filter by industry name, for example "Financial Services" or "Technology". Repeat the parameter to filter on multiple industries.

params.name: size
params.description: Filter by company size. One of "Small Size", "Medium Size", or "Large Size".

params.name: location
params.description: Filter by location, for example "Charlotte, NC".

params.name: api_key
params.description: Optional API key that raises the hourly rate limit.

items.docs: Returns a paginated list of employer company profiles. Supports filtering by industry, company size, and location. Returns up to 20 results per page.

params.name: id
params.description: The numeric ID of the company.

params.name: api_key
params.description: Optional API key that raises the hourly rate limit.

items.docs: Retrieves a single employer company profile by its numeric ID.
